item.title: Advancing AI Benchmarking with Game Arena
item.description:
📝 We are updating Kaggle Game Arena with two new games — Werewolf and poker — to benchmark how models navigate social dynamics and calculated risk. Game Arena expands beyond chess to include Werewolf, testing social deduction and communication skills in AI models. Last year, Google DeepMind partnered with Kaggle to launch Game Arena, an independent, public benchmarking platform where AI models compete in strategic games.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-deepmind/kaggle-game-arena-updates/

item.title: EPA Advances Farmers' Right to Repair
item.description:
📝 Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) advanced American farmers and equipment owners’ lawful right to repair their farm and other nonroad diesel equipment. Not only has this made repairs more costly, but it has also caused many farmers to opt for older agricultural equipment that lack modern emission controls simply because they can fix that equipment themselves. Importantly, farmers and equipment owners are not required to rely on authorized dealers exclusively to fix equipment.
🔗 Read more: https://www.epa.gov/newsreleases/epa-advances-farmers-right-repair-their-own-equipment-saving-repair-costs-and
